# VAR-PLAN-0011: Ingress excluded by class filter

- Severity: warning
- Area: PLAN

## Description

An Ingress was excluded from the plan because its class does not match the requested one, so no case was planned for it.

## Remediation

Plan without the class filter, or with the class the Ingress declares. The exclusion is reported because it can change the plan: an excluded use-regex Ingress makes ingress-nginx match every path of its host as a regex, and the planner computes that host scope over the included resources only, so the change would stay invisible.
